title: HR Assistant Chatbot
tagline: n8n + Claude-powered HR chatbot handling leave management, policy Q&A, certificates, and automatic Loss-of-Pay salary deduction — no HRMS required.
description: An AI agent chatbot built for startups that need real HR admin automation without an HR platform. Employees log in with Employee ID + PIN and can check leave balances, apply for leave (Casual/Sick/Vacation/Loss-of-Pay) through a genuine manager-approval gate, ask free-text HR policy questions grounded in the company's actual policy document, and request an experience certificate generated on demand. Loss-of-Pay requests automatically calculate that month's salary deduction (monthly gross salary ÷ 21.7 per day) and log it for payroll — no separate attendance-tracking system required. Built entirely on n8n workflows, Google Sheets as the data backend, and Claude as the reasoning engine, with a custom-branded standalone chat interface for deployment outside n8n's own editor.
highlights: Real in-charge approval gate for leave requests — not a self-certification checkbox
Automatic Loss-of-Pay salary deduction (monthly gross ÷ 21.7/day), logged for payroll
Autogeneerates salary slips and emails to employees
Autogenerates consolidated salary payment sheet and emails to HR for payment initiation
Free-text HR policy Q&A grounded in the actual company policy document
On-demand experience certificate generation, emailed to HR for letterhead printing
No HRMS subscription — built entirely on n8n, Google Sheets, and Claude
Custom-branded standalone chat interface (via @n8n/chat), separate from n8n's own editor UI
